sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你打造了终极的《办公室》爱好者播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们将通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 幕后花絮，还有许多闺蜜的故事。

sentences.en: I'm sitting across from my friend, my friend.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在我的朋友对面，我的朋友。

sentences.en: Oh, that's how I would talk to my kitty cat.
sentences.zh: 哦，我平时就是这样跟我家小猫说话的。

sentences.en: And also, we're doing something that's kind of touching my heart this morning.
sentences.zh: 而且，今天早上我们要做一件挺触动我心的事情。

sentences.en: We are going to break down the paper, Scam Alert, Episode 5.
sentences.zh: 我们要剖析《纸业公司》的第5集《诈骗警报》。

sentences.en: But first, you guys, we're going to kick things off with an Around the Town.
sentences.zh: 但首先，各位，我们要以一个“城市周遭”环节来开场。

sentences.en: This is the segment we've been wanting to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我们一直想做的环节。

sentences.en: You guys remember, in our breakdown of Episode 2 of the paper, I shared about my grandmother
sentences.zh: 大家还记得吗，在我们剖析《纸业公司》第2集时，我分享了我外祖母

sentences.en: She would document little slice-of-life moments happening in my hometown of Archer City, Texas.
sentences.zh: 她会记录下我的家乡德克萨斯州阿彻市的生活点滴。

sentences.en: And we just loved this idea.
sentences.zh: 我们太喜欢这个主意了。

sentences.en: So, we decided to make it part of our show.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们决定把它做成我们节目的一部分。

sentences.en: And we asked you all to send in your Around the Town tidbits and moments.
sentences.zh: 我们邀请大家发来你们的“城市周遭”趣闻和生活片段。

sentences.en: And we're going to start sharing them in these episodes as we continue to break down the paper.
sentences.zh: 在我们继续剖析《纸业公司》的同时，我们将开始在这些剧集里分享它们。

sentences.en: Yeah, and since this is the first one, we thought we'd kick off the episode with it.
sentences.zh: 对，既然这是第一期，我们觉得用这个来给节目开场最合适。

sentences.en: Office ladies reporting for Around the Town.
sentences.zh: 办公室女士“城市周遭”报道组，随时待命。

sentences.en: This one is from Catalina in Newton, Kansas.
sentences.zh: 这一条来自堪萨斯州牛津市的卡塔利娜。

sentences.en: And Catalina put her Around the Town in the newsy jargon.
sentences.zh: 而且卡塔利娜用新闻式的行话写了她的“城市周遭”。

sentences.en: Like the way your grandma wrote them.
sentences.zh: 就像你外祖母写的那种风格。

sentences.en: Miss Catalina Bergman and her mother, Mrs. Robert Bergman, started the new year with a visit to the Van Gogh Experience in Wichita, followed by Lunch at the Dairy Queen.
sentences.zh: 卡塔利娜·伯格曼小姐和她的母亲罗伯特·伯格曼太太以参观威奇托的梵高体验展开启了新的一年，随后在冰雪皇后的DQ餐厅用了午餐。

sentences.en: I love Lunch at the DQ.
There's something about eating it at lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐吃这个总有一种别样的感觉。

sentences.en: I love any of their baskets.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢他们家的各种套餐。

sentences.en: You know, their chicken finger basket and the gravy with the french fries and the toaSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们的鸡柳套餐，还有配炸薯条和吐司的肉汁。

sentences.en: Well, next up, this is from Trista N.
sentences.zh: 那么接下来，这条来自阿尔伯塔省的……
加拿大阿尔伯塔省的特里斯坦·N。

sentences.en: She says, I live in a small town in Alberta, Canada called Morinville.
sentences.zh: 她说，我住在加拿大阿尔伯塔省一个叫莫林维尔的小镇。

sentences.en: We used to have this beautiful Catholic church that was built in 1907, but unfortunately, it burned down in 2021.
sentences.zh: 我们以前有一座美丽的天主教堂，建于1907年，但不幸的是，它在2021年被大火烧毁了。

sentences.en: Before it was burnt down, the church bells used to ring all the time, and it was just such a cozy feeling.
sentences.zh: 在被烧毁之前，教堂的钟声总是响个不停，那种感觉真的很温馨。

sentences.en: It took some time to rebuild it, and the church bells finally rang once again after almost five years yesterday.
sentences.zh: 重建它花了一些时间，就在昨天，时隔将近五年，教堂的钟声终于再次敲响了。

sentences.en: It was such a great feeling to hear them ring again.
sentences.zh: 再次听到钟声响起，那种感觉真是太棒了。
我的意思是，这很有意义。

sentences.en: That they rebuilt them and to hear them ring, I mean...
sentences.zh: 他们重建了教堂，还能听到钟声敲响，我是说……

sentences.en: It just feels like such a, I don't know, very poetic, symbolic of, you know, rebuilding.
sentences.zh: 就让人觉得，怎么说呢，非常富有诗意，象征着，你懂的，重建。
来自华盛顿州贝灵厄姆，她说，

sentences.en: So, we have a lot of large, tall trees along the freeway up here.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们这里的公路沿线有许多又大又高的树。

sentences.en: Someone put a giant sloth way up in one of the trees, and you could see it from the freeway as you drive north.
sentences.zh: 有人在高高的树上挂了一只巨大的树懒，你开车往北走时从公路上就能看到它。

sentences.en: Well, the Washington State Department of Transportation took it down.
sentences.zh: 结果，华盛顿州交通运输部把它给取下来了。

sentences.en: But that did not dissuade the good people of Bellingham from bringing the sloth spirit back.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有打消贝灵厄姆好心市民们重燃树懒精神的念头。

sentences.en: After several back and forths of the sloth going up and WSDOT taking it down,
sentences.zh: 经过好几个回合的树懒被挂上去、华盛顿州交通运输部又把它取下来的拉锯战之后，

sentences.en: the mystery sloth person somehow managed to get the sloth to new heights so that it could not be brought down.
sentences.zh: 这位神秘的树懒达人居然设法把树懒送到了更高的高度，让人再也够不着把它取下来。

sentences.en: So, slothy has been up there ever since and has a spotlight lit up on him somehow at night for all to easily see him from the freeway.
sentences.zh: 所以，树懒从小到大一直都在那儿，不知怎么的，晚上还给它打了一束聚光灯，让大家在公路上能轻而易举地看到它。

sentences.en: That is so amazing to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说太不可思议了。

sentences.en: It's kind of great that, I guess, the Washington State Department of Transportation was like,
sentences.zh: 我觉得挺棒的，华盛顿州交通运输部大概觉得，

sentences.en: well, it's high enough up now, it's safe, they love it, clearly, it has its own spotlight, we're leaving it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在挂得够高了，很安全，而且大家显然都很喜欢它，还有它自己的聚光灯，我们就由它去吧。

sentences.en: I want to drive by it.
sentences.zh: 真想开车去从它旁边路过。

sentences.en: Well, thank you guys all so much for writing in your Around the Towns.
sentences.zh: 好吧，非常感谢大家写信分享你们的“城市周遭”故事。

sentences.en: We'll keep sharing these as the weeks go by.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们会继续分享这些内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, you can find the folder to share on officeladies.com Around the Town.
sentences.zh: 对，你们可以在 officeladies.com 的“城市周遭”板块找到分享文件夹。

sentences.en: I feel like my grandmother would be so proud.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我奶奶要是知道了会觉得特别骄傲。

sentences.en: Well, now it is time for our chit-chat question of the week, and it's coming from Amy H.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在是我们每周的闲聊问答时间，这个问题来自加利福尼亚州圣克拉里塔的艾米·H。
加利福尼亚州圣克拉里塔。

sentences.en: I might have had a hand in selecting this one.
sentences.zh: 我可能参与挑选了这个问题。

sentences.en: Hi, I've been a faithful listener since day one and absolutely loved the show.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我从第一天起就是忠实听众，而且超级喜欢这个节目。

sentences.en: I used to be up in the middle of the night pumping for my baby girl,
sentences.zh: 我过去常常在半夜醒来给宝贝女儿吸奶，

sentences.en: and I would listen to The Office Ladies or re-watch an episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 那时我会听《办公室女士》或者重温一集《办公室》。

sentences.en: It honestly brought me so much joy during postpartum and through COVID, so thank you so much for that.
sentences.zh: 在产后和疫情期间，它真的带给我数不清的快乐，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Jenna and Sam, you mentioned that you both lift weights.
sentences.zh: 珍娜和萨姆，你们提到过你们两个都举重。

sentences.en: What do your workouts usually look like?
sentences.zh: 你们平时的锻炼通常是怎样的？

sentences.en: Thanks again for all your laughs and heart you've put into the show.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你们为节目付出的欢笑和用心。

sentences.en: You all feel like friends at this point.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，你们感觉就像朋友一样。

sentences.en: I love to talk about weightlifting.
You get real sort of, I don't know, like that perky face.
sentences.zh: 你就会变得有点，我不知道，就像那种神采奕奕的样子。

sentences.en: I would love to give an update on my weightlifting.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意分享一下我最近举重的进展。

sentences.en: I have been weightlifting for over a year now,
sentences.zh: 我开始举重已经有一年多了，

sentences.en: and I am so passionate about it.
sentences.zh: 而且我对它充满了热情。

sentences.en: I weightlift with Body Fit by Amy.
sentences.zh: 我跟着艾米的身体塑形（Body Fit by Amy）进行举重训练。

sentences.en: You're inspiring me that 2026 is going to be the year I weightlift because of you.
sentences.zh: 因为你，你让我觉得2026年将是我开始举重的一年。

sentences.en: You leave me such great messages about it,
sentences.zh: 你为此给我留了好多超棒的语音消息，

sentences.en: and it makes you feel so empowered.
sentences.zh: 而且它会让你觉得充满了力量。

sentences.en: I'm like, I want to get on this train.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我也要搭上这班车。

sentences.en: Listen, after breaking my shoulder and all that cancer treatment,
sentences.zh: 听着，在经历骨折和所有那些癌症治疗之后，

sentences.en: I am stronger physically than I've ever been in my life because I used to work out,
sentences.zh: 我身体的强壮程度达到了我人生的巅峰，因为我以前也锻炼过，

sentences.en: but my workouts were always, I mean, if I'm being honest,
sentences.zh: 但我的锻炼总是——说实话的话，

sentences.en: they were all geared toward burning calories, losing weight, maintaining weight.
sentences.zh: 它们全都是为了燃烧卡路里、减肥、维持体重。

sentences.en: But the weightlifting is about something else.
sentences.zh: 但举重则完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: It's about being physically strong and capable in my body.
sentences.zh: 它关乎让我的身体变得强壮且充满力量。

sentences.en: And for me, it's also about, you know, making me have less side effects from my medications
sentences.zh: 对我来说，它还关乎，你知道的，减少药物带来的副作用，

sentences.en: because it's been proven that that really helps.
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I can't say enough great things about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是觉得，我对它的赞美简直无以复加。

sentences.en: And I want to say, I have been lifting weights for over a year
sentences.zh: 而且我想说，我举重已经一年多了，

sentences.en: with no change on the number to the scale.
sentences.zh: 体重秤上的数字一点都没变。

sentences.en: This is really about, like, being capable.
sentences.zh: 这真的完全关乎，比如说，变得更有能力。

sentences.en: But I have lost an inch and a half in my waiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我的腰围减了整整一寸半。

sentences.en: So it's like, things are, like, reforming.
sentences.zh: 所以就像是，身体在进行重塑。

sentences.en: Are you, you're still weightlifting, right?
So I've been doing CrossFit is what I've been doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在在练的是CrossFit综合体能训练。

sentences.en: And it's super easy to make fun of, and you should,
sentences.zh: 这超级容易被拿来开玩笑，你们也尽管笑吧，

sentences.en: because people that do CrossFit are crazy.
I, Sam, can I say that I used to meet a group of friends for brunch,
sentences.zh: 我，山姆，我能说我以前经常和一群朋友去吃早午餐吗？

sentences.en: and we'd be having, like, the biggest pancakes and bacon and mimosas,
sentences.zh: 我们会点那种最大的煎饼、培根和含羞草鸡尾酒，

sentences.en: and the CrossFit group in the valley would go running past us,
sentences.zh: 而山谷里的那个CrossFit训练团会从我们旁边跑过去，

sentences.en: like, holding, like, tires and shit.
sentences.zh: 手里还抬着轮胎之类的鬼东西。

sentences.en: It's one of those, like, how do I describe it?
sentences.zh: 这属于那种……我该怎么形容呢？

sentences.en: It's definitely geared towards single guys in their 40s.
sentences.zh: 它绝对是为四十多岁的单身汉量身打造的。

sentences.en: But it's, it's like a lot of cardio and weightlifting together.
sentences.zh: 但它包含大量的有氧运动和举重结合。

sentences.en: So it's like sets of things.
sentences.zh: 所以它是按组来训练的。

sentences.en: You'll do five sets of running a mile, and then 100 burpees, and then 50 sit-ups.
sentences.zh: 你会做五组跑步一英里，接着100个波比跳，然后50个仰卧起坐。

sentences.en: I once did a burpee challenge where you're supposed to do one burpee each day,
sentences.zh: 我曾经参加过一个波比跳挑战，要求每天做一个波比跳，

sentences.en: but then you increase by one for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 但在30天里每天递增一个。

sentences.en: Who challenged you to do this?
sentences.zh: 谁向你发起的这个挑战？

sentences.en: And by the end of the challenge, you know, by the end of the month, you're doing 30.
sentences.zh: 到了挑战结束时，你知道的，到月底的时候你得做30个。

sentences.en: I feel like I've told this story before.
sentences.zh: 我感觉我以前好像讲过这个故事。

sentences.en: I threw my back out on day three.
sentences.zh: 我在第三天就把腰给扭了。

sentences.en: I did three burpees, and I was done.
sentences.zh: 我做了三个波比跳，然后就结束了。

sentences.en: But I wonder, could I do, I'm afraid to try.
sentences.zh: 但我在想，我能不能行，我有点怕去尝试。

sentences.en: Just keep lifting my heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, and things.
sentences.zh: 还是继续举我的重哑铃、壶铃这些东西吧。

sentences.en: I told Josh, I was like, Jenna's really inspired me to weight lift.
sentences.zh: 我跟乔希说，我说珍娜真的启发我去举重了。

sentences.en: And he was like, son of a bitch.
I've been telling you how healthy it is and how good it is for you that he's very physically fit,
sentences.zh: 我一直跟你说这有多健康、对你有多好，他身材非常健美，

sentences.en: and he has a very structured weightlifting thing that he does.
sentences.zh: 而且他有一套非常系统化的举重训练计划。

sentences.en: He does this every day, no matter where we are.
sentences.zh: 他每天都这样，不管我们在哪。

sentences.en: Well, here's the thing with weightlifting, too.
sentences.zh: 而且，举重这事儿是这样的。

sentences.en: Does Josh eat, like, a ton of protein, Sam?
sentences.zh: 山姆，乔希是不是吃超多蛋白质的？

sentences.en: Are you like, like, I can't with the protein.
sentences.zh: 你会不会觉得，天呐，蛋白质真的吃够了。

sentences.en: Pretty much all I eat is chicken breasts, broccoli, and brown rice.
sentences.zh: 我基本上吃的全都是鸡胸肉、西兰花和糙米。

sentences.en: Josh eats so much protein, and sometimes I'm like, I need a break.
sentences.zh: 乔希吃了太多蛋白质，有时我都觉得，我需要歇会儿。

sentences.en: But you know what I mean?
I need a break from the chicken.
sentences.zh: 我吃鸡肉吃腻了，想换换口味。

sentences.en: The chicken, the chicken, the chicken.

sentences.zh: 我发现了这种蛋白奶昔。

sentences.en: I think they have, like, 32 grams per shake or something.
sentences.zh: 我想它们每瓶大概有32克蛋白质什么的。

sentences.en: They were very low-rated on a shake-tasting article I read.
sentences.zh: 我在一篇测评奶昔的文章里看到，它们的评分非常低。

sentences.en: But their complaints about the shake were all the things I liked about it.
sentences.zh: 但他们对这款奶昔的吐槽，正好都是我喜欢它的地方。

sentences.en: They're like, it's a little thin and watery.
sentences.zh: 他们说，它有点稀，像水一样。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I like it.
I don't want, like, a super thick dairy shake.
sentences.zh: 我才不想喝那种超级浓稠的奶昔呢。

sentences.en: This is a non-dairy, plant-based protein.
sentences.zh: 这是不含乳糖的植物蛋白。

sentences.en: They said it tastes a little chalky.
sentences.zh: 他们说喝起来有点粉质感、粉粉的。

sentences.en: Okay, we'll have to share it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我们得分享一下了。

sentences.en: You want some of my watery, chalky shake?
sentences.zh: 你想尝尝我那水水的、粉粉的奶昔吗？

sentences.en: But someone listening might, Amy might like to know about it.
sentences.zh: 但听节目的某个人可能会想，艾米也许会想了解一下。

sentences.en: Angela, will you put my shake in stories?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你能把我的奶昔发到快拍里吗？
你那水水的、粉粉的奶昔？
我个人非常喜欢的那款。

sentences.en: I like both the vanilla and the chocolate.
sentences.zh: 香草味和巧克力味我都喜欢。

sentences.en: And speaking of people named Amy, I want to give a plug to my trainer, Amy, who I now work out with
sentences.zh: 说到名字叫艾米的人，我想给我的教练艾米打个广告，我现在跟她一起

sentences.en: in person, but for, like, four years, I just did her videos on YouTube until I was hiking one day.
sentences.zh: 进行线下训练，不过大约四年来，我只是在YouTube上看她的视频锻炼，直到有一天我在徒步时。

sentences.en: And she was like, Jenna, I'm Amy.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，珍娜，我是艾米。

sentences.en: You post my videos on your Instagram.
She's like, yeah, I live here.
She's like, do you want to come work out with me sometime?
sentences.zh: 她说，你什么时候想跟我一起去健身吗？

sentences.en: I know this story, but I love it every time you tell it because it was so meant to be.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个故事，但每次你讲我都听不够，因为这简直是命中注定。

sentences.en: It was so meant to be.
And she's just so, like, I mean, half of our training sessions are just her, like,
sentences.zh: 而且她简直是，我是说，我们的训练课有一半时间都是她在，比如说，
清除我大脑里的消极想法。

sentences.en: You know, like, she's, like, part therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像，她有点像半个治疗师。

sentences.en: And her whole Instagram and all of her YouTube videos, they have that same energy.
sentences.zh: 而且她的整个Instagram和所有的YouTube视频，都有那种相同的能量。

sentences.en: Well, I'll share her account as well.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我也会分享她的账号。

sentences.en: Well, and I don't weight lift, but I do run my ass off every week because I play a lot of tennis.

sentences.zh: 他问梅尔，我资料里可以写点什么军事术语吗？

sentences.en: And she says, well, you could say you like squids, which means the Navy.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，嗯，你可以说你喜欢乌贼，也就是海军的意思。

sentences.en: And then she's like, but I want to see your whole profile.
sentences.zh: 接着她说，不过我想看看你的全部资料。
然后她大声朗读了出来。

sentences.en: I may be six foot three, but I still like being the little spoon.
sentences.zh: 我可能身高六尺三，但我还是喜欢当被抱在里面那个。

sentences.en: No, I just thought it was cute.
sentences.zh: 没，我只是觉得这挺可爱的。

sentences.en: I thought it was cute, too.
She also sorts through all his photos, and she's like, you look rich in almost all of them.
sentences.zh: 她还挑遍了他所有的照片，然后说，你几乎每张照片里看起来都很有钱。

sentences.en: You look rich or you look like Diane Keaton.
sentences.zh: 你看起来很有钱，或者看起来像黛安·基顿。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's like, what is it with you and headwear?
sentences.zh: 对，她就说，你跟各种帽子到底有什么仇？

sentences.en: And then she's like, what is this sport?
sentences.zh: 然后她就问，这算什么运动？

sentences.en: Do you have your own pickleball court?
sentences.zh: 你连自己的匹克球场都有？

sentences.en: And he's like, no, no, no.
My uncle put in platform tennis.
sentences.zh: 是我叔叔装的平台网球场。

sentences.en: In fact, that's what he used on his whole like mayoral campaign is that we're middle class.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他整个市长竞选打出的旗号就是我们是中产阶级。

sentences.en: Well, listen, another thing that has happened is that Detrick is going to approach Nicole
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，还发生了一件事，那就是德特里克要去找妮可

sentences.en: and say, well, I've reactivated my latch profile.
sentences.zh: 然后说，嗯，我重新激活我的拉奇交友资料了。

sentences.en: Gosh, I have a lot of messages, including one from the weather gal at WNWO.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我有好多消息，其中一条还是 WNWO 气象女主播发来的。

sentences.en: And Nicole's like, you should hang out with her.
sentences.zh: 然后妮可就说，你应该跟她出去约会。

sentences.en: She wants to hang out tonight.

sentences.zh: 她对他是如此不屑一顾。
她当时正在写这封邮件。

sentences.en: What she's doing is she's sending this massive email, basically exposing the fact that Esmeralda
sentences.zh: 她正在做的是发送一封长篇大论的邮件，基本上揭露了埃斯梅拉达
正在遭遇网络钓鱼的事实。
这是一封尖酸刻薄、阴阳怪气的邮件。

sentences.en: I don't understand how that doesn't get you fired, but that's okay.
sentences.zh: 我不明白这怎么能不被开除，不过也无所谓了。

sentences.en: She just wants everyone to know.
sentences.zh: 她就是想让所有人知道。

sentences.en: But she's doing this snarky email takedown of Esmeralda.
sentences.zh: 但她正在写这封尖酸刻薄的邮件来痛击埃斯梅拉达。

sentences.en: And at the same time, just being an a-hole to Detrick.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对德特里克又是个混蛋。

sentences.en: Like, in addition to the way she treats him, she's not very nice.
sentences.zh: 比如，除了她对待他的方式外，她人其实也不太好。

sentences.en: I don't know what's up with Nicole.
I actually found an interview that Ramona did with Nerds of Color.
sentences.zh: 我实际上找到了雷莫娜接受“有色极客”采访的视频。

sentences.en: And she talked about why she thinks Nicole is so fickle with showing her feelings.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了为什么她认为妮可在表达感情时如此反复无常。

sentences.en: Nicole doesn't come from the best examples of love in her paSt.
sentences.zh: 妮可过去的爱情经历并不是很好的榜样。

sentences.en: And the fact that she was previously in love with someone who was married really weighed on her.
sentences.zh: 而且她以前深爱过一个已婚之人的事实，确实给她带来了沉重的负担。

sentences.en: And so that is something that she thinks is keeping her from trusting herself.
sentences.zh: 所以她认为正是这一点让她无法信任自己。

sentences.en: They also asked her to pick three words to describe her character.
sentences.zh: 他们还让她选三个词来描述她的角色。

sentences.en: And these are the three words she picked.
sentences.zh: 这就是她选择的三个词。

sentences.en: And I found the sensitive one was very curious to me.
sentences.zh: 我发现“敏感”这个词让我觉得很好奇。

sentences.en: So I'm going to want to see more of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想看到更多这方面的表现。

sentences.en: It's been established that Esmeralda has not been nice to Nicole.
sentences.zh: 大家已经知道埃斯梅拉达对妮可一直不太好。

sentences.en: And she's probably just been waiting for a moment for something like to turn, right?
sentences.zh: 她大概一直都在等一个转机之类的时刻吧？

sentences.en: And so maybe that happened in this episode.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这一集里就发生了这样的事。

sentences.en: So now Esmeralda is going to come back out to the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 现在埃斯梅拉达要回到大办公室了。

sentences.en: It's also pretty clearly a cameo video.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显是一个明星祝福视频。

sentences.en: I feel like we should play it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该放来看看。

sentences.en: Jarson just sent me proof his love for me is real.
sentences.zh: 贾森刚刚发给我证据，证明他对我的爱是真的。

sentences.en: This is Jarson to let you know just how adored you really are, Esmeralda.
sentences.zh: 我是贾森，想让你知道你究竟有多受宠爱，埃斯梅拉达。

sentences.en: Now, I hope this proves to your office friends that Jarson is real.
sentences.zh: 现在，我希望这能向你办公室的朋友们证明贾森是真的。

sentences.en: So my sweetie just proved that his love for me is real.
sentences.zh: 所以我的小甜心刚刚证明了他对我的爱是真的。

sentences.en: And he just looks like that Josh Halloween person.
sentences.zh: 而且他看起来就像那个万圣节的乔什。

sentences.en: He's speaking in the third person.
And Oscar kind of calls that out.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡有点指出了这一点。

sentences.en: And Esmeralda is like, people do that all the time.
sentences.zh: 而埃斯梅拉达则觉得，大家经常这么做。

sentences.en: Esmeralda thinks you guys are all stupid.
sentences.zh: 埃斯梅拉达觉得你们这群人都很蠢。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Renata C.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自雷娜塔·C的粉丝提问。
嗨，来自佛罗里达州坦帕市的雷娜塔。

sentences.en: Renata wants to know, how did they get Josh Holloway to play himself?
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔想知道，他们是怎么请到乔什·霍洛韦来演他自己的？

sentences.en: And where did the storyline come to use him as the catfish person?
sentences.zh: 以及让他扮演那个网恋骗子的剧情是怎么来的？

sentences.en: Well, Moe said Josh Holloway was just perfect for Jarson.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莫说乔什·霍洛韦简直是杰森的不二人选。

sentences.en: When they were in the writer's room, they thought of him because they wanted to find a famous person
sentences.zh: 当他们在编剧室时，他们想到了他，因为他们想找一个名人

sentences.en: who had played a famous character.
sentences.zh: 曾扮演过某个著名的角色。

sentences.en: But if you happened to have not watched that show, you might not recognize them.
sentences.zh: 但如果你碰巧没看过那个节目，你可能认不出他们。

sentences.en: And she said that was true for her.
sentences.zh: 她说过这对她来说就是真的。

sentences.en: She said, I had never watched LoSt.
sentences.zh: 她说，我从来没看过《迷失》。

sentences.en: And probably Esmeralda never has either.
sentences.zh: 而且埃斯梅拉达可能也没看过。

sentences.en: So they were like, this is amazing because he's so famous for LoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以他们觉得，这太棒了，因为他因《迷失》而非常有名。

sentences.en: And yet, if you never watched the show.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你从未看过这个节目。

sentences.en: It is believable that she might not know.
sentences.zh: 她可能不知道，这也是可信的。

sentences.en: And so that is how they settled on him.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他们决定选他的原因。

sentences.en: And that Josh Holloway was just game from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 而且乔什·霍洛韦从一开始就很乐意配合。

sentences.en: And he's so good in it.
sentences.zh: 他在里面表现得太好了。

sentences.en: We also got a question from Martina B.
sentences.zh: 我们还收到了来自丹佛的

sentences.en: I was wondering if you all had any catfish stories.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们大家有没有什么网恋受骗的故事。

sentences.en: Or was there ever a time when a friend of yours was like,
sentences.zh: 或者有没有那么一次，你们的朋友跑来对你们说：

sentences.en: oh, I saw someone pretending to be you catfishing other people?
sentences.zh: 哦，我看到有人冒充你在网上骗别人？

sentences.en: Well, you know, that's interesting, Martina.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，这很有趣，玛蒂娜。

sentences.en: I feel like we both have had people pretend to be us on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们俩都在Instagram上遇到过别人冒充我们。

sentences.en: But it doesn't say it's a fan account.
sentences.zh: 但它上面没有写这是粉丝账号。

sentences.en: And they find photos of you and post them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会找到你的照片并发布出来。

sentences.en: And everybody has always been really nice.
sentences.zh: 而且每个人一直都非常好。

sentences.en: Like if someone comes across that, they tell me.
sentences.zh: 如果有人碰巧遇到了，他们会告诉我。

sentences.en: And then I can be like, hey, guys, that's not me.
sentences.zh: 然后我就可以说，嘿，伙计们，那不是我。

sentences.en: But we asked Mo, the writer, if she'd ever been catfished because she wrote this episode.
sentences.zh: 但我们问了编剧莫，她有没有被网恋骗过，因为这集是她写的。

sentences.en: She said, I have been scammed so many times.
She says, I'm just a dumb girl from normal Illinois.
sentences.zh: 她说，我只是个来自普通伊利诺伊州的笨女孩。

sentences.en: She actually highlighted one scam that happened to her and her wife, Samantha.
sentences.zh: 她实际上强调了发生在她和她妻子萨曼莎身上的一起骗局。

sentences.en: I guess they got pulled into this frozen yogurt scam in West Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 我猜他们被卷入了西好莱坞的一场冻酸奶骗局。

sentences.en: It happened when they were first dating.
sentences.zh: 那是在他们刚开始约会的时候发生的。

sentences.en: But this scam, this yogurt scam ended up taking them all the way to Vegas.
sentences.zh: 但这个骗局，这个酸奶骗局最终让他们一路去了拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: And she says she has a nickname for her wife.
sentences.zh: 她说她给她妻子起了一个绰号。

sentences.en: Well, Mo went on to say that she has been trying to find a place to force the storyline into something.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莫接着说，她一直想找个机会把这个故事线强行塞进什么地方。

sentences.en: And she was so glad she got to put this catfishing idea into an episode.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴能把这个网恋诈骗的想法写进其中一集里。

sentences.en: My identity has been used to try to catfish someone.
sentences.zh: 我的身份曾被用来试图对别人进行网络诈骗。

sentences.en: And I'm actually happy that I can talk about it because I haven't known how to let people know.
sentences.zh: 我其实很高兴能谈论这件事，因为我一直不知道该怎么让大家知道。

sentences.en: This person let my manager know that they had received an email.
sentences.zh: 这个人告知我的经纪人说他们收到了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: And here's what the email said.
It said, hi, I hope you're doing well.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，嗨，希望你一切都好。

sentences.en: My name is Liam Carter, and I manage Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我叫利亚姆·卡特，我负责管理珍娜·费舍。

sentences.en: My manager's name is Naomi Odenkirk.
sentences.zh: 我经纪人的名字叫娜奥米·奥登科克。

sentences.en: Listen to what they said in their email.
sentences.zh: 听听他们在邮件里是怎么说的。

sentences.en: Liam, fake Liam, says, we're excited to invite you to be a guest on Jenna's podcast,
sentences.zh: 利亚姆，也就是假利亚姆，说，我们很高兴邀请您作为嘉宾参加珍娜的播客，

sentences.en: Office Ladies, which she hosts with Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》，这是她和安吉拉·金西共同主持的节目。

sentences.en: We will offer you $2,000 for your participation.
sentences.zh: 我们将为您提供2000美元的参与报酬。

sentences.en: The interview will be conducted virtually via Facebook and run approximately 30 to 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 采访将通过脸书以虚拟方式进行，大约持续30到45分钟。

sentences.en: So this person sent this email to someone and then...
sentences.zh: 所以这个人把这封邮件发给了某个人，然后……

sentences.en: Yeah, so they did it to another person, too.
sentences.zh: 对，所以他们对另一个人也做了同样的事。

sentences.en: And what they're doing is they are targeting writers of books.
sentences.zh: 他们的做法是，他们把目标对准了图书作家。
我想大概是知名度不高的作家。

sentences.en: They're going out and they're saying, Jenna loved your book.
sentences.zh: 他们主动联系对方，说，珍娜很喜欢你的书。

sentences.en: And she wants you to be a guest on Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 她希望你成为《办公室女士》的嘉宾。

sentences.en: But then they say that the interview happens on Facebook Live.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们说采访是在脸书直播上进行。

sentences.en: We might get Facebook, but we're not on Facebook right now.
sentences.zh: 我们以后可能会弄个脸书，但我们现在没有脸书。

sentences.en: Yeah, we might someday have an Office Ladies official Facebook, but we don't.
sentences.zh: 对，我们以后可能会有一个《办公室女士》的官方脸书，但现在没有。

sentences.en: But what's confusing to me is they're offering to pay the author $2,000 to come on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 但让我感到困惑的是，他们主动提出付给作者2000美元邀请他来上播客。

sentences.en: Oh, also, the email address that these are coming from is a Gmail address.
sentences.zh: 哦，还有，发这些邮件的邮箱地址是一个Gmail邮箱。

sentences.en: So I also just want to say to everybody out there, if someone who says they're representing
sentences.zh: 所以我也想对所有听众说，如果有人自称他们代表

sentences.en: Office Ladies or me personally, they're not going to have a Gmail address.
sentences.zh: 《Office Ladies》或者代表我本人，他们绝对不会用Gmail邮箱。

sentences.en: They're going to have an Odyssey email address, or they're going to have a William Morris Endeavor
sentences.zh: 他们会用Odyssey的邮箱地址，或者用威廉莫里斯奋进经纪公司的

sentences.en: All of my representatives have their own whatever those are called.
sentences.zh: 我的所有代表都有他们自己的，不管那叫什么。
我的意思是，他们说得很具体。

sentences.en: They sent a letter to another author that said,
sentences.zh: 他们给另一位作者发了一封信，上面写着：

sentences.en: Jenna admires your heartfelt storytelling and would be honored to host you for a virtual
sentences.zh: 珍娜非常欣赏你真挚动人的故事讲述，如果能邀请你在7月22日到30日晚上8点

sentences.en: Facebook Live podcast between July 22nd and 30th at 8 p.m.

sentences.zh: 来参加一场虚拟的Facebook直播播客，将是莫大的荣幸。

sentences.en: What happens if these people show up to the Facebook Live?
sentences.zh: 如果这些人出现在Facebook直播里会发生什么？

sentences.en: I had my lawyer look into it.
sentences.zh: 我让我的律师调查过这事。

sentences.en: We looked into it, and it never really made any sense to me.
sentences.zh: 我们调查过了，这事我一直觉得挺莫名其妙的。

sentences.en: I didn't understand the end game here.
sentences.zh: 我搞不懂他们最终想达到什么目的。

sentences.en: And also, that's not how we do things.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们做事也不是这样的。

sentences.en: But I'm looking at the emails, and they look very professional.
sentences.zh: 但我看了看那些邮件，它们看起来非常专业。

sentences.en: So yeah, my identity has been used.
sentences.zh: 所以没错，我的身份被冒用了。

sentences.en: We've talked to a lot of friends, even our fellow castmates and different projects we've
sentences.zh: 我们和很多朋友聊过，甚至包括我们合作过不同项目的

sentences.en: And a lot of people do have people posing online as them at some point.
sentences.zh: 很多人都遇到过在网上被人冒充的情况。

sentences.en: It usually ends up with the person somehow receiving money.
sentences.zh: 通常结局都是那个人不知怎么就收到了钱。

sentences.en: And that's what's going to happen in this next scene.
sentences.zh: 接下来的这个场景里，事情就会这样发展。

sentences.en: Esmeralda is going to keep sending money to Jarson.
sentences.zh: 埃斯梅拉达会一直给贾森汇钱。

sentences.en: That scene where she just keeps clicking send, and she's sending him 50 bucks at a pop.
sentences.zh: 就是她一直在点发送的那个镜头，一次五十刀地给他打钱。

sentences.en: Oh, and Ned is like, please stop, stop.
sentences.zh: 哦，内德在一旁说，求求你停下，快停下。
我尴尬得都快缩成一团了。
我数过叮咚的提示音了。

sentences.en: So much money in like the course of 12 seconds.
sentences.zh: 大约在12秒的时间里花掉了这么大一笔钱。

sentences.en: She thinks that this is how she's taking care of him.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这就是她在照顾他。

sentences.en: This is how she's rationalizing it.
sentences.zh: 她是这样给自己找理由的。

sentences.en: You know, I know he needs me, and I'm caring for him, and this is going to make him happy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，“我深知他需要我，我在照顾他，这会让他感到快乐”。

sentences.en: Well, one of the things Nicole's been busy doing is she has bought a cameo from Josh
sentences.zh: 好了，妮可一直在忙的事情之一，就是她从乔什·霍洛威那里买了一段卡梅奥视频

sentences.en: Holloway, and she's going to play it for everyone.
This is her final takedown of Esmeralda.
sentences.zh: 这是她对埃斯梅拉达的最终绝杀。

sentences.en: It's me, Josh Holloway from Lost, Yellowstone, and that underseen show Colony.
sentences.zh: 我是我，演过《迷失》、《黄石》以及那部被严重低估的剧集《殖民地》的乔什·霍洛威。

sentences.en: Anyway, your coworker, Nicole, bought this for you on Cameo so you could hear it from me.
sentences.zh: 总之，你的同事妮可花了钱在卡梅奥上买下这个，好让你能亲耳听到我这么说。

sentences.en: I don't know how our wires got crossed.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们俩是怎么搞混的。

sentences.en: I just say what they tell me to say on here.
sentences.zh: 我只是照着他们让我在这里说的话念而已。

sentences.en: I'm in love with my wife, Jessica.
sentences.zh: 我爱的人是我妻子杰西卡。

sentences.en: I did love that the camera quickly panned to Oscar when he said mahalo.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢当他说出“马哈洛”时，镜头迅速扫向奥斯卡的那个画面。
奥斯卡一副“我就知道”的表情。

sentences.en: Esmeralda is just visibly shaken by this.
sentences.zh: 埃斯梅拉达对此显然受到了极大的打击。
而且她感到受到了羞辱。

sentences.en: And this episode is going to end with Esmeralda up on the roof.
sentences.zh: 这一集的结尾将是埃斯梅拉达来到屋顶上。

sentences.en: She's saying a bunch of stuff in Italian.
sentences.zh: 她嘴里叽里咕噜说了一大堆意大利语。

sentences.en: I don't know what, but she's not happy.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体在说什么，但她显然很不高兴。

sentences.en: And Ned is going to go up there.
He's going to say, I'm really sorry.
He might also drop a Lost spoiler.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还可能剧透一下《迷失》。

sentences.en: Maybe we won't say it in case you guys haven't watched LoSt.
sentences.zh: 也许我们就不说了，万一你们还没看《迷失》呢。

sentences.en: And then he gives her a huge hug.
sentences.zh: 然后他给了她一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: And he says, you know what?
We're going to run the story, but we're not going to expose Esmeralda.
sentences.zh: 我们要把这篇报道做出来，但我们不会曝光埃斯梅拉达。

sentences.en: We're going to leave her out of it.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把她牵扯进来。

sentences.en: He says, the award can wait.
And Mare really did help him with his profile.
sentences.zh: 而梅尔确实帮他写了人物专访。

sentences.en: So much so, he got asked out, which seems to bump Mare.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还被人约出去了，这似乎让梅尔有点不高兴。

sentences.en: But then he doesn't go out with the lady.
sentences.zh: 但后来他并没有跟那位女士去约会。

sentences.en: He actually, I believe he says he doesn't like pizza.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我相信他说的是他不喜欢披萨。

sentences.en: I think there's more coming up for Mare and Ned.
sentences.zh: 我觉得梅尔和内德后面还会有更多故事。

sentences.en: I'm just going to say, I did jump ahead.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我确实提前看过了。
我已经把接下来两集看完了。
那里的剧情越来越精彩了。

sentences.en: I'm like rooting for something that I hope happens in the finale.
sentences.zh: 我正盼着某件我希望能在季终集发生的事情成真呢。

sentences.en: We'll get to it, you guys.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿会聊到这个的，大家伙儿。

sentences.en: We want to give a big thank you to Mo Welch for chatting with us about this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们要向莫·韦尔奇表示诚挚的感谢，感谢她跟我们一起聊这一集。

sentences.en: I did ask her if we're going to see more of Kimberly in season two.
sentences.zh: 我确实问过她，我们在第二季里还会不会看到更多金伯莉的戏份。

sentences.en: And she said, yes, Kimbo is back for more in season two.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的，金博在第二季里还会带来更多精彩表现。

sentences.en: I do look forward to that.
She said, playing a toilet paper salesperson comes really naturally to me.
sentences.zh: 她说，扮演一个卫生纸推销员对我来说简直轻车熟路。

sentences.en: I also want to say thank you to Kathleen Felix Hager, the costume designer for this show.
sentences.zh: 我还想感谢本剧的服装设计师凯瑟琳·菲利克斯·黑格。

sentences.en: And she said we can hit her up if we have any questions for the rest of the series.
sentences.zh: 她说接下来的剧集如果我们有什么问题都可以找她。

sentences.en: And also, thanks to all of you.
You can find the folders to submit a chit-chat question, to submit your around-the-town info,
sentences.zh: 你可以找到提交闲聊问题的文件夹，提交你身边的城镇信息的文件夹，

sentences.en: and also to send us any questions you might have about the paper.
sentences.zh: 以及向我们发送你对本报纸可能有任何疑问的文件夹。

sentences.en: We love hearing from you guys, and we hope you have a good one.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴听到你们的反馈，并希望你们过得愉快。

Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》是 Odyssey 的一档节目，由詹娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金西制作。

sentences.en: Our executive producer is Cassie Jerkins.
sentences.zh: 我们的执行制片人是卡西·杰金斯。

sentences.en: Our audio engineer is Sam Kiefer.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是萨姆·基弗。

sentences.en: And our associate producer is Ainsley Bubbico.
sentences.zh: 我们的副制片人是英斯利·布比科。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producer is Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: Odyssey 的执行制片人是莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由比尔·舒尔茨进行混音和母带处理。
